taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-04, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 4201.4 | 5.06 | 5.06
2 | 2238.9 | 4.35 | 9.41
3 | 343.9 | 31.91 | 41.32
4 | 25.0 | 0.99 | 42.31
5 | 10.9 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation, we first list the resistivities of the layers in order:
1. $r_1 = 4201.4$ $\Omega\text{m}$
2. $r_2 = 2238.9$ $\Omega\text{m}$
3. $r_3 = 343.9$ $\Omega\text{m}$
4. $r_4 = 25.0$ $\Omega\text{m}$
5. $r_5 = 10.9$ $\Omega\text{m}$

Next, we examine every group of three consecutive layers:
- **Layers 1-2-3**: $4201.4 > 2238.9 > 343.9 \rightarrow$ This follows the pattern $r_1 > r_2 > r_3$, which is **Q**.
- **Layers 2-3-4**: $2238.9 > 343.9 > 25.0 \rightarrow$ This follows the pattern $r_2 > r_3 > r_4$, which is **Q**.
- **Layers 3-4-5**: $343.9 > 25.0 > 10.9 \rightarrow$ This follows the pattern $r_3 > r_4 > r_5$, which is **Q**.

The resulting sequence of letters is QQQ. According to the rules provided, if all letters are the same, the curve may be written as that single letter.

{"curve_type": "Q"}
